headlines.title: Oklo, Centrus Secure Fuel Supply for Aurora Powerhouse Deployment in Ohio
headlines.summary: PIKE COUNTY, Ohio, November 12, 2026--Oklo Inc. (NYSE: OKLO) ("Oklo"), an advanced nuclear technology company, today announced it has signed multiple definitive, multi-year contracts with Centrus Energy Corp. (NYSE: LEU) ("Centrus"), a uranium enrichment and nuclear fuel services provider, for high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU). Under the agreements, Oklo will make prepayments for future HALEU deliveries to support construction of new U.S. uranium enrichment capacity with Centrus.

headlines.title: Stegra and Meta sign agreement for environmental attribute certificates to advance green steel
headlines.summary: Stegra has signed a multi-year agreement with Meta for environmental attribute certificates (EACs) linked to Stegra's green steel plant in Northern Sweden, currently under construction. As part of the agreement, the EACs associated with the physical steel are verified by an accredited third party. Meta is purchasing EACs to drive demand for lower carbon materials, address emissions in its supply chain, and help scale and finance early-stage manufacturing.

headlines.title: Nevoya and Meta Expand Partnership with 25 New Electric Trucks on the I-10 Corridor
headlines.summary: Nevoya, an AI-native electric truckload carrier, today announced a multi-year agreement with Meta that support the deployment of 25 Class 8 battery-electric trucks on the Interstate 10 (I-10) between San Bernardino, California and Phoenix, Arizona. The deal includes bringing online electric trucking charging infrastructure with the 25 deployed trucks' charging matched 100% with renewable energy certificates.

headlines.title: Sublime Systems and Meta Sign Agreement to Scale U.S. Manufacturing of Next Generation Low-Carbon Cement
headlines.summary: SOMERVILLE, Mass., November 12, 2026--Sublime Systems, a U.S. manufacturer scaling clean, innovative cement production, today announced an agreement that grants Meta priority access to physically deploy Sublime Cement across its data center construction pipeline. As hyperscalers build new AI infrastructure, Sublime’s products represent a meaningful and verifiable approach for reducing emissions from data center construction.

headlines.title: Pershing Square Calls Meta’s (META) Business Model “One of the Clearest Beneficiaries of AI Integration”
headlines.summary: We just published a list of the 10 Best Growth Stocks to Buy for the Next Decade and Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) ranked 6th on this list. On November 5, the S&P 500 fell 4.36%, its worst day since the April 2025 tariff crash, with roughly $3 trillion in value wiped off S&P 500 companies.

description: Meta Platforms, Inc. engages in the development of products that enable people to connect and share with friends and family through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses in the United States, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL). The FoA segment offers Facebook, which enables people to build community through feed, reels, stories, groups, marketplace, and other; Instagram that brings people closer through Instagram feed, stories, reels, live, and messaging; Messenger, a messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls; Meta AI, an assistant that's available across apps, as a stand-alone app, on AI glasses, and on the web; Threads, an application for text-based updates and public conversations; and WhatsApp, a messaging application that is used by people and businesses to communicate and transact. The RL segment provides virtual and augmented reality products, including consumer hardware, software, and content that help people feel connected, as well as Meta Quest devices that enable social experiences across gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. The segment also includes wearables such as AI glasses like Ray Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses; and the Meta Ray Ban Display, which combines AI glasses with an integrated lens display and the Meta Neural Band, a wrist worn device using electromyography that lets people control their AI glasses through neuromuscular signals. Meta Platforms, Inc. has a collaboration with Microsoft Corporation, NVIDIA Corporation, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., Broadcom Inc., and OpenAI, L.L.C. The company was formerly known as Facebook, Inc. and changed its name to Meta Platforms, Inc. in October 2021. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, California.
